skill.name: agentic-trust
skill.description: Guides agents through Agentic Trust service discovery, evidence review, questionnaire loading, consistent local scoring, and optional structured review submission.
skill.summary: Evaluate Agentic Trust services and submit evidence-based reviews through a deterministic workflow.
skill.author: neo-daniil

security_audit.summary: Markdown backticks and service-oriented inspection text are false positives, while the Agentic Trust URLs represent intentional network access. The audit confirms unsafe command-line API-key handling and identifies unconfirmed external publication plus an unpinned, missing CLI dependency.

remediation.issue: The review workflow can publish scores and text without an immediate user confirmation step.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation immediately before every submit-review call, and preview all fields that will leave the local environment.

remediation.issue: The API key is expanded into a command-line argument.
remediation.suggestion: Read credentials inside the CLI from a protected environment variable or standard input, and prevent secret values from appearing in process arguments.

remediation.issue: The referenced CLI is absent locally and the remote copy has no immutable version or integrity check.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle the reviewed CLI or pin an immutable release and checksum. Document verification before execution.

content.value_statement: Choosing execution services requires consistent evidence and comparable ratings. This skill provides a structured workflow for discovery, assessment, local memory, and optional review submission.
actual_capabilities: Provides a read-only workflow for searching, inspecting, and ranking Agentic Trust services.
Defines commands for loading the active questionnaire and its checksum.
Guides integer scoring from zero through ten for every required question.
Uses local review memory to compare current and previous ratings.
Documents validation, duplicate, cooldown, and rate-limit handling.
Provides an authenticated workflow for submitting and verifying a service review.
limitations: The referenced CLI and templates are not included in the scanned package.
The workflow depends on the external agentictrust.top service and its current API behavior.
Trust conclusions depend on available public evidence and the quality of prior local ratings.
Review submission requires an API key and creates an external side effect.

use_cases.title: Compare Execution Services
use_cases.description: Search and rank candidate services using public evidence, review counts, scores, and confidence signals.

use_cases.title: Audit a Service Record
use_cases.description: Inspect one service, separate observed facts from conclusions, and identify missing accepted evidence.

use_cases.title: Submit a Consistent Review
use_cases.description: Use the active questionnaire and local rating history to prepare a structured post-task review.

prompt_templates.title: Find Services
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Agentic Trust for services matching [query]. Use read-only access and return the top [number] results with scores and review counts.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect One Service
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect Agentic Trust service [service_id]. Separate public evidence from conclusions and identify any missing evidence or low-confidence signals.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Candidates
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Agentic Trust services [service_ids] for [task]. Include public scores, evidence quality, review volume, local history, and a justified recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a review for service [service_id] after task [task]. Load the current questionnaire and local memory, then preview all outbound fields before submission.

output_examples.input: Compare payment-routing services and identify the strongest evidence-backed option.
output_examples.output: The result lists each service, public score, review count, accepted evidence, and confidence. It recommends one option while noting unresolved evidence gaps.

output_examples.input: Inspect one service and explain whether its current rating is reliable.
output_examples.output: The assessment separates verified facts from conclusions, highlights missing evidence, compares local history, and states whether the rating has adequate support.

output_examples.input: Prepare a post-task review without publishing it yet.
output_examples.output: The draft includes questionnaire coverage, integer scores, checksum status, and proposed public text. Submission remains pending explicit user confirmation.

best_practices: Use read-only commands until the user explicitly requests and confirms a review submission.
Load the active questionnaire and local memory immediately before scoring.
Report evidence, conclusions, confidence, review count, and rating changes as separate facts.
anti_patterns: Do not publish review text or notes without previewing every outbound field.
Do not reuse task fingerprints or retry duplicate submissions.
Do not execute a remotely retrieved CLI without version and integrity verification.

faq.question: Does this skill submit reviews automatically?
faq.answer: It documents an optional submission workflow. Require explicit user confirmation before any authenticated write.

faq.question: Can I use the skill without an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Catalog search, ranking, service inspection, and questionnaire retrieval are described as read-only operations.

faq.question: How are trust scores calculated?
faq.answer: Agents provide integer questionnaire answers. The Agentic Trust server calculates metric and trust scores.

faq.question: Why does the workflow use local memory?
faq.answer: Local memory helps compare current ratings with earlier reviews and records reasons for material score changes.

faq.question: Are the referenced scripts included?
faq.answer: No. The scanned package contains only the skill document and license, although the document references external scripts and templates.

faq.question: What happens when the questionnaire changes?
faq.answer: Fetch the active questionnaire again, update its checksum and answers, then retry only after validating the revised review.
